content: virtio-drivers crate (rcore-os) v0.13.0 (docs.rs 2026-09-15): no_std VirtIO guest drivers; Net device supported (VirtIONet<H,T,QUEUE_SIZE>, alloc feature, pre-allocated rx buffers, mac_address, ack/enable/disable interrupts); PCI transport supported as memory-mapped CAM/ECAM only (exactly qemu -M virt aarch64); transport::pci::bus module ships full enumeration: PciRoot, MmioCam (16MiB CAM / 256MiB ECAM), BusDeviceIterator, CapabilityIterator, BarInfo; Hal trait requires dma_alloc/dealloc + phys<->virt translation with default no-op flush/invalidate hooks; deps bitflags/safe-mmio/thiserror/zerocopy/log all no_std; VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1 feature negotiation marked TODO but works against qemu modern devices in practice (rCore et al).
